newsitem.title: UK: Logica hits high on French acquisition.
newsitem.headline: Logica hits high on French acquisition.

text.p: British software group Logica Plc shares rose on Thursday to a record high after announcing the acquisition of computer services unit Axime Ingenierie SA.
Shares chalked up a record high of 888-1/4p before easing slightly to be up 25p at 886-1/2p by 1010 GMT in modest volume.
Logica payed 18.4 million stg for the French company, which is part of computer services group Axime.
"The acquisition makes good sense financially and strategically," said one analyst.
"It is likely to be taken well and, in the medium term, the signs are encouraging," he added.
Logica said it expected the acquisition to add a small contribution to its earnings in the current financial year. -- Nick Winning, London Newsroom +44 171 542 7954
